summary: REGENXBIO Inc. filed a Form 8-K under Items 2.02, 7.01, 8.01, and 9.01 on May 14, 2026. The filing reports first quarter 2026 financial results and discloses topline and interim data from the pivotal Phase III AFFINITY DUCHENNE trial of RGX-202. No transaction, acquisition, divestiture, or corporate restructuring is announced. The filing is a routine disclosure of operational and clinical updates, without any special-situation event. The registrant's role is filer of a standard current report. No deal terms are present.
